newsitem.title: UK: Scottish Power seen eyeing debut Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Scottish Power seen eyeing debut Eurobond.

text.p: British utility Scottish Power was expected to launch its debut Eurobond in the next few weeks, syndicate sources said on Wednesday.
They said given the ripe conditions for the pound, the offering was likely to be a sizeable sterling bond.

A syndicate official at HSBC said the bank was arranging investor presentations for Scottish Power on January 21 and 22 in London and Scotland. He said speculation on terms and conditions of the issue was premature.
A syndicate manager at a rival British bank said: "I am quite sure it will be very well received."
Scottish Power is an electricity generation and supply firm which also has interests in gas and telecommunications.

A flurry of sterling issues hit the market in the first week of the year. The market is buoyed by the strength of the currency and investor belief that it will remain a high-yielding market while well outside European economic and monetary union.
